fact: Malawi's DHIS2-based One Health Surveillance Platform, interoperable with the national HMIS through the interoperability layer, scaled nationwide from 2020 and reached 97.8% completeness and 74.5% timeliness of weekly IDSR reporting in 2024.
title: Establishing One Health Surveillance Platform for Electronic Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response in Malawi: Action Design Research Study
